summary: Uni-Fuels Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a proxy statement and notice for an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for September 8, 2026. The only proposed item is a special resolution to adopt a third amended and restated memorandum and articles of association, changing the written resolution approval threshold for ordinary resolutions from unanimous consent to majority voting rights. The meeting will be held remotely, with a record date of August 18, 2026. No special-situation transaction, such as acquisition or restructuring, is involved; it is a routine governance matter, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
